paragraphs: Quantcast’s mission to optimise real‑time ad auctions with AI mirrors my recent work building a tool‑calling LLM agent that delivers precise, actionable insights for complex scientific problems.

I built a tool‑calling LLM agent using LangChain, AWS Bedrock and Claude Haiku 4.5 for a multi‑omics cancer research platform, integrating three specialised tools for gene alias resolution, scoring‑methodology explanation and dataset provenance.
I also constructed scikit‑learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deploying them as FastAPI services in Docker.
Could we schedule a brief call so I can walk you through how these experiences translate to driving measurable outcomes for Quantcast’s advertisers?
